[h2]GAME[/h2]
In a world where demons and humans coexist, the elite members of the organization [Demon-Slaying Warriors], which stands against the demon threat, face a family crisis! 

S-rank Demon-Slaying Warriors Mizuki, Cecilia, and Rekka learn that Mizuki's daughter Akari has failed her infiltration mission and been captured. To rescue Akari, the three infiltrate the demons' lair, but they are discovered by the enemy. 

Cecilia and Rekka get caught in the demons' schemes, while Mizuki ventures alone into the [Breeding Dungeon] where her daughter is held. 

The harsh trials awaiting her shake Mizuki's heart and bonds... Resist and protect to the end—the epic battle to save her beloved family begins now! 

Will Mizuki and the others successfully rescue Akari? Witness the touching conclusion together.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] High-Frequency Event System: New developments unfold every time you explore the Breeding Dungeon! A stress-free, smooth progression design.
[*] No Leveling Required: Jump straight into the main story with a simple system. 
[*] Battles emphasize strategy for a refreshing experience!
[*] Voice & Animation: Lively character expressions and voice acting deliver maximum immersion.
[*] Multiple Character Selection: Choose from 3 types—housewife, tough mom, or sister—for play. Unique experiences based on each attribute!

[h2]GAME[/h2]
Long, long ago, there existed a kingdom shrouded in dense mist: the Lost Empire.
This mist twisted humans into terrifying beasts, plunging the world into despair.

War raged endlessly.
Heroes rose, seeking fame and glory.
Courtesans dreamt of royal ballroom dances.
Treasures lay hidden within secret gardens.

All gathered here, only to vanish into obscurity.
It is in this place you awaken—
a nameless undead.
As the protagonist of this grim tale, what will you witness, and what will you gain?

May you avoid meeting the darkest of ends…

[list]
[*] Highly open-ended exploration in an open world.
[*] Selectable player class.
[*] Symbol Encounter system.

We've packed in a lot of interesting RPG elements. You can play the mini-game "Jack Poker" or earn money by working part-time at the tavern...
You can get equipment by loot or crafting. Please try to aim for the most powerful equipment. There are also unique pieces of equipment that are one of a kind.
Monsters, ingredients, literature, weapons... tons of things can be collected.

HENTAI Plan is a new brand that will focus on releasing interesting and fun "Adult only" games!

[h2]Story[/h2]
One of the naturally occurring phenomena, "Dungeons."
These places, whimsically created by gods who govern heaven and earth, have captured the hearts of many.
People eventually become adventurers, and a culture of challenging various dungeons developed.

One day, two adventurers challenge a newly born dungeon.
They are the protagonist (senpai) and a junior adventurer named Nao.

It is a dangerous and unknown dungeon from which the research team has withdrawn, and the leader, the doctor, was taken away by monsters.
Along the way, Nao is attacked by a monster and falls into a special abnormal state.
To treat Nao, the protagonist picks up a paper dropped by the abducted doctor.

What kind of ending will this adventure have?

[h2]Game[/h2]
Treat the heroine Nao, who is afflicted with various abnormal states, in erotic ways!
Nao loves her senpai from the beginning, so she will forgive him no matter what!
Use lovey-dovey treatments to conquer the dungeon!

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h2]STORY[/h2]
The sun has vanished, and darkness corrodes the world. Great sages rise to reclaim the sun, only to meet their demise. 

In the midst of this chaos, an angel named Helvetica is summoned. She claims to be "an angel that surpasses even the gods" and initially repels the distorted sun goddess. However, in order to restore the sun, she must capture the goddess. The goddess curses her, causing her to lose all her powers and preventing her from returning to her original world.

Helvetica embarks on a never-ending adventure with a diverse group of companions she meets along the way, with the goal of saving the world.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] JRPG 
[*] Endless dungeon available
[*] Multiple endings 
[*] Hairstyle and outfit changes possible
